aboutSubheading: Chelsea Heights' trusted joinery and interior fitout specialists
aboutText: Based in Chelsea Heights, Dawson Interiors has been delivering premium joinery and interior fitout solutions to homes and businesses across Melbourne's south-east for over 15 years. Our small, dedicated team combines traditional woodworking skills with modern design techniques to create interiors that are as functional as they are beautiful. Every project is managed in-house from initial consultation through to final installation, ensuring consistent quality and attention to detail at every stage.

testimonialsSubheading: Real feedback from homeowners and businesses across Melbourne's south-east

testimonials.text: Dawson Interiors built our entire kitchen from scratch and the result is absolutely stunning. The attention to detail in the cabinetry and the way they worked with our architect made the whole process stress-free. Couldn't recommend them more highly.
testimonials.name: Trent Mitchell

testimonials.text: We had our office fitout done by the Dawson team and they were brilliant from start to finish. They stuck to the timeline, kept the site tidy, and the finished result looks incredible. Our clients always comment on how professional the space looks.
testimonials.name: Sarah Langford

testimonials.text: After getting quotes from a few different joiners, we chose Dawson Interiors because they genuinely listened to what we wanted. The built-in wardrobes they created for our bedrooms are exactly what we envisioned — great quality timber and perfect finish.
testimonials.name: David Kowalski
